'''Adapted Longarms''' are a [[Mobs|Mob]] placed into the [[Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawns after a [[Primitive Longarms]] accumulates a killcount of 30 and [[Evolution System|evolves]].
* Spawns naturally in groups of 2 to 3, if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 3 or higher, with a spawnweight of 15.
* Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 10.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Adapted Longarms are highly mobile melee combatants with AoE capabilities. 

* Adapted Longarms' melee attack inflicts AoE damage and is performed by them swinging their tentacles.
*If the [[Generations|Generation]] is 4 or higher, Adapted Longarms can perform the following abilities:
**Generate shock waves, large damaging areas of disturbed ground. After standing still for a brief period they will summon a shock wave which moves forward at slow speed attempting to break any blocks they contact. Shock waves ignore immunity frames and deal massive vertical knockback.
*** This is indicated by flame particles and a higher pitched growl. They will also stand still before performing this attack.
** Like other Adapted Parasites, vomit [[Residue]] in a 5x5 area every so often.
* Their attack damage increases the lower their HP is. Adapted Longarms' damage will increase by 100% for every HP they lose.
* Adapted Longarms can climb blocks.
* Adapted Longarms can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
* Adapted Longarms can sink in liquids to pursue submerged enemies.
* Adapted Longarms can break blocks with [[Hardness]] value up to 3, with a 1-block range and a 40 tick cooldown.
{{Variants|count=4|Berserker=BerserkerAdaLongarms.png|Virulent=VirulentAdaLongarms.png|Breacher=BreacherAdaLongarms.png|Texture=TyrantAdaLongarms.png|TextureName=Tyrant|TextureDesc=inflicts double the damage but has half the HP.}}

===''Weaknesses''===
* Like all Parasites, Adapted Longarms are weak to fire. Damage inflicted by fire is quadrupled.
* Adapted Longarms's Tendrils, found on the sides of their body, can reset their [[Adaptation System|adaptation]] when cut off, as well as giving them the [[Bleeding]] and [[Rage]] effects.

===''Post Death''===

* On death, Adapted Longarms have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Adapted Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** If at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Adapted Longarms will become [[Primitive Longarms]] upon death instead.

==''Trivia''==
*Adapted Longarms are inspired by [https://deadspace.fandom.com/wiki/Slasher Slashers] and [https://doom.fandom.com/wiki/Hell_Knight/Doom_3 Hell Knights], from Dead Space and Doom 3 respectively.
*Adapted Longarms are known as '''Shyco''' internally.
*In the mod's files, there are two unused variant textures called '''shycoaabyss''' and '''shycoalovecraft'''. It is unknown why they went unused.
